properties.name: A client keeps the tool list it fetched at connection: after the shared server was restarted on a new binary, the new add_verification fields were serialized as strings and refused — the server had the feature and the session could not reach it
properties.statement:
OBSERVED 2026-09-06 while recording the verification for the one-call constructors. Sequence: the binary was rebuilt with add_verification's new `verifies` / `status` / `findings` / `last_run_at`; the shared daemon was stopped with --stop-shared and respawned from the new binary; the next add_verification call from the SAME session was refused with `unknown field findings` — the client-side stdio bridge had re-attached to the new daemon, but the harness's tool list, fetched at connection, still described the old schema, so the harness serialized the `verifies` array as a JSON string and the server, which now knew the field, refused the type. A second attempt after re-fetching the tool schema through the harness's own tool search returned the OLD schema again: the list is cached per connection and nothing told the client it had changed. Workaround: the three-call form (add_verification, verifies, set_verification_status).

WHAT THIS IS: the third face of the currency problem. cap:the-server-knows-its-own-currency says whether the SERVER's executable was replaced; fact:a-fresh-server-on-an-old-build-is-not-stale-and-stamps-confidently says a fresh server on an old build cannot know; this says the CLIENT can be stale against a fresh server, and the server cannot tell it. MCP has a `notifications/tools/list_changed` message for exactly this; whether the stdio bridge forwards one after a daemon respawn, and whether this harness honours it, is not established — the observed behaviour says at least one of the two does not.

WHY IT MATTERS OUTSIDE reflow2: every consumer who updates reflow2 mid-session (the one-word update is the recommended path) meets this on the first new parameter they try, and the refusal text — `unknown field` / `expected a sequence` — points at their call, not at the stale list. Bounded fix candidates: the bridge emits tools/list_changed after respawn; the refusal for an unknown field says 'your client's tool list may predate this server — reconnect'. Neither taken here; recorded under rule:a-reflow2-tool-failure-met-while-working-is-captured-as-a-to-do.

BOUNDS: one harness (Claude Code), one session, two attempts; not reproduced on a fresh connection, where it is expected to work.
properties.value: {"tool":"add_verification","new_fields":["verifies","status","findings","last_run_at"],"refusals":["unknown field findings","invalid type: string, expected a sequence"],"server_restarted":true,"client_reconnected":false,"list_changed_seen":false,"workaround":"three-call form"}
